T1: On a fully closed hour, close below minimum low of six preceding contiguous closed hours queues exit for next tradable bar; no arbitrary six-hour timeout or fixed profit cap
T2: T1 plus stop=max(previous_stop, previous_six_hour_low-0.25*current_Wilder_ATR14), effective only on the next tradable bar
fixed_targets: net target multiples of frozen BASE unit risk including actual entry fee and BASE exit fee/slippage; original other exit rules retained
gap: unverifiable path separately censored; never synthesize missing prices
terminal: explicit terminal liquidation, not normal strategy exit
selection: no automatic winner selection or parameter search
validation: holding overlap must be remeasured; original six-hour embargo cannot be reused mechanically
